query: How do I make garlic toast?

goal.title: Make pan-toasted garlic bread
goal.description: Slice a short bread roll into two pieces and set them aside. Crush, slice and repeatedly mince a garlic clove on the board. Put butter in a small bowl, scrape the minced garlic into it and mash and stir the mixture with a spoon. Wipe the board, spread the garlic butter over the cut surfaces of both bread pieces and heat a frying pan on the gas burner. Lay both pieces buttered side down in the pan, wait while adjusting the burner and checking a piece with a spatula, then lift the browned pieces onto a plate and move the pan away.
goal.final_state: Two garlic-buttered bread pieces with browned toasted faces lie on a white plate on the cutting board. No eating is shown.
procedure: Cut the bread roll into two pieces.
Combine the garlic and butter in a small bowl.
Spread the garlic butter on both bread pieces.
Heat the pan and place the coated bread faces against it.
Toast, check and transfer the browned bread to a plate.

phases.description: Cut the short roll into two pieces and move both to the upper side of the board.
Press the garlic under the knife, cut it smaller, gather it and repeatedly mince it.
Put butter portions into the small bowl, scrape in the minced garlic and mash and stir them with a spoon.
Set utensils aside, tear a paper towel and wipe the board, then spread garlic butter across the cut face of each piece.
Move and heat the frying pan, place both pieces coated side down, wait, adjust the burner and lift an edge to check the toasting.
Use the spatula and a supporting hand to move each browned piece onto the plate, move the pan away and reposition the plate.
